text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
"Daisuki daisuki Haiseiko♪" Fufu, that's 
the cheer my fans chant!

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"You invited them to the live show the 
other day, right? It seems they really 
took a liking to it since then. I catch 
them humming the tunes every now and 
then."

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
"It was excellent. The sheer intensity was 
astonishing. Truly... on par with a race 
itself."

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Yes, absolutely! The fans are just so 
intensely passionate...!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Standing on stage, you feel that massive 
surge directly... yeah, that's right. It 
feels just like a race!

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
"Well... I've just thought of a wonderful 
idea."

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...May I take a guess? —You are planning 
to take the stage, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
"Precisely. It has been quite some time 
since we stepped away from all that 
fervor. I simply felt like reminiscing for 
a moment."

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Kya~, that's amazing♪ Fans of both of you 
will be so thrilled!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Leave the choreography and song choices to 
me! As an active idol, I'll whip you right 
into shape♪

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hold on. Unless my ears deceive me, did I 
just hear you say "a fan of both of 
you"...?

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Of course! It's a wonderful twist of fate, 
after all. —Let's make a new legend 
together♪
